visibleTestCases.title: Threshold Alert Triggering on Brute-Force Pattern
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Mgr} = gen_event:start_link(), ok = security_audit_handler:add_to_manager(Mgr, 3), gen_event:sync_notify(Mgr, {login_failed, <<"192.168.1.5">>}), gen_event:sync_notify(Mgr, {login_failed, <<"192.168.1.5">>}), gen_event:sync_notify(Mgr, {login_failed, <<"192.168.1.5">>}), Res = security_audit_handler:get_ip_status(Mgr, <<"192.168.1.5">>), gen_event:stop(Mgr), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Three consecutive failed logins toggle alert flag to true.
